title: Other user profiles on this Mac
whyItMatters: Other accounts have their own home folders under /Users. The machine may hold data belonging to people other than the person handing it over.
source: SPEC.md platform roots: USERS = /Users; other profiles are reported by directory name only (path jail rule 6)
notes: Names only. excludeHome drops the current account; no recursion into any profile, and no symlink is followed.
